title: Quartz Drops Like Lapis
description: Matches the loot-table of Lapis Lazuli Ore to Quartz Ore
body:
## Tired of low quartz yields on your trips to the nether? This is the perfect Datapack for you!

This Datapack simply changes the loot-table to match Lapis Lazuli Ore. It should work exactly the same, enchantments and all (exceptfor the fact that it obiously drops _Quartz_ instead of Lapis).

Yay for more quartz!


### This pack will only be updated periodically, not _every_ Minecraft update.
